attchmntText: Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that Shri Ashwin Dani, Company's Vice Chairman and Managing Director has sold 31,000 equity shares and purchased 31,000 equity shares of the Company on March 24, 2005. The shareholding of Shri Ashwin Dani after the said transactions is 1,41,156 equity shares aggregating to 0.15% of the total share capital of the Company.

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company's Director, Shri K. Rajagopalachari passed away on March 14, 2005.

Asian Paints India Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Press Release of Berger International Limited (BIL), Singapore, which is listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange. BIL is a subsidiary of Asian Paints (India) Limited. The Press Release is the announcement of BIL results for the year ended December 31, 2004. The details of the press release shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the company's new paint plant at Sriperumbudur, near Chennai in the state of Tamil Nadu commenced production today after the formal inauguration. The plant is located in the SIPCOT(State Industrial Promotion Corporation of Tamilnadu)Industrial Park,Sriperumbudur about 30 kilometers from Chennai on the National Highway to Bangalore. The plant has been established to manufacture emulsion paints alone with an initial capacity of 30,000 KL per annum. The capacity will be raised in phases to 1,00,000 KL per annum.

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company has issued a press release on January 19, 2005 titled 'Asian Paints Consolidated Net Profit Increases by 41.19%, Net sales for the group has increased by 28.74%'. The details of the press release shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BOD of the company in their meeting held on December 03, 2004, approved the following: 1) Disinvestment/transfer of shares held in Asian Paints (Mauritius) Limited, a subsidiary of Asian Paints (India) Limited to a local party, subject to necessary approvals and due diligence. The Company holds 89.6% of the equity of Asian Paints (Mauritius) Limited and has invested Rs.111.1 million till date. For the financial year ended March 31, 2004, the Company had made a provision of Rs.68 million towards diminution in value of investment in Asian Paints (Mauritius) Ltd; 2) Setting up a new plant at Taloja, Maharashtra for the manufacture of Industrial Liquid Paints. The first phase of the project with a capacity of 8000 KL would involve a capital expenditure of Rs.148.8 million.

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BOD of the company in their meeting held on October 27, 2004, have approved 1) the payment of interim dividend of Rs.4.00 per equity share of Rs.10/- each (40%) for the FY ending March 31, 2005, and 2) November 02, 2004 as the Record Date for the payment of interim dividend. The interim dividend will be paid to the shareholders after November 05, 2004.

Asian Paints India Ltd has informed the Exchange that subject to the approval of the BoD's, the Company has announced November 02, 2004 as the Record date for the purpose of payment of interim dividend. The dividend, if approved by the BoD's, will be paid after November 05, 2004.

News Verification : The press had reports that Asian Paints India Ltd has put its chemical business on the block, as part of a restructuring exercise.The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. Asian Paints India Ltd has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "The company wishes to place on record that at present the company is not in discussion with any organisation for the sale of the chemical business. Further, we would like to state that the capacities of the chemical business units comprising Phthalic Anhydride and Pentaerythritol have not been ramped up last year, as reported in the news item".
